title: Produce dual-mono and silent channel slots through Opus mapping metadata

definition.title: Produce dual-mono and silent channel slots through Opus mapping metadata
definition.source_excerpt: Use legal Ogg Opus output-channel mappings to duplicate an existing mono coded channel or declare a silent slot. Preserve packets, gain, pre-skip and timeline; this is assignment, not spatial upmixing.
definition.impact_basis: Narrow source or deliberately altered-output operation; qualify actual demand before implementation. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used.
definition.minimum_probe: Use one tiny admitted source plus one unsupported/near-boundary control through the existing destination or adapter; compare required output identity with the cheapest correct route. No broad codec port.
definition.initial_screen: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used. definition.primary_metric: Correct additional admitted source/destination capability; otherwise full startup and CPU/resource cost.
definition.scope_contract: Configuration and ordered codec payloads where copy is intended; requested frames/audio/timeline/features at the declared output boundary.
definition.negative_control: Alter one admission-critical configuration, remove a required dependency, or preserve video while making selected audio unsupported. Candidate must reject or use a declared fallback.
definition.stop_boundary: Stop before a new demuxer, player, codec build family or delivery service is needed. Record precisely which next implementation would unlock the screen.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Exact destination/configuration and existing source/worker assets; feature availability is not a pass for the complete route.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

define.basis: Exact full-key mechanism, bounded workload, matched baseline and predeclared threshold.

prepare.basis: Fixtures, source/runtime hashes, independent PCM oracle, adverse and lifecycle controls pinned.

correctness.basis: Actual mono Opus mapping family1 streams1/coupled0 [0,0] and[0,255] retain coded packets, preskip/gain/endgranule. All96000stereo frames match same-consumer mono duplication/silence in Chrome and libopus, with native render/EOF/closed. Wrong source/intent/cancellation guards reject. Default FFmpeg native Opus decoder incorrectly zeros both channels for silent-right; that destination remains excluded and failed run is retained. With efficient strided PCM expansion baseline, complete cold remap/CRC/write/libopus consumption ratios1.11953 dualmono and1.29753 silent fail0.9. Earlier generator-based baseline diagnostic is retained but not accepted.

performance.basis: Stop this complete cold mapping/consumption cost profile. Metadata capability is real for Chrome/libopus, but default native FFmpeg silent-slot fidelity is not. Prepared packet mapping or another workload must separately remeasure; no spatial upmixing or production routing claim.
